about: E116: a failed run whose cause was external (an outage, a quota, a platform limit, no file of ours at fault) may be dispatched again with the same inputs and no new commit only when it is listed here by PR: {"run": <failed run id>, "reason": "<the external cause, with its evidence>"}. ops/dispatch_guard.py reads it (GUARD_RERUN_WITHOUT_FIX).

retries.reason: External outage: episode.yml build step 'Tools, pinned voice runtime...' could not download the pinned SyncNet weights; curl exit 28 four times (Failed to connect to www.robots.ox.ac.uk port 443 after ~135 s, 21:40-21:47Z 2026-10-31). No file of ours involved; the same URL also reset from this session at 21:50Z.

Same external outage again on the re-dispatch after PR590 (about 21:55-22:03Z 2026-10-31): the tools step could not download the pinned SyncNet weights from www.robots.ox.ac.uk (connection failures); no file of ours involved; the URL also reset from this session at 21:53Z.

No code at fault (E248): the caller never sent the master bytes to the run's saved resumable upload_url, so the provider had no file and 'Await exact-byte upload' timed out (receipt status AWAITING_EXACT_BYTES). The exact 100766072 bytes (sha 57e8768c...1829) were sent to that upload_url at 04:30Z 2026-11-01 (HTTP 200, state PROCESSING, size matches); the resume reuses that upload.
